info.name: SwiftRide - API Grading
info.description: Run entire collection once, sequentially, with SwiftRide Local environment and 500ms request delay. Development/test only: creates users/trips/payments and changes two demo Drivers availability. Requires fresh isolated data and seeded Drivers. Gateway only. Payment is ledger simulation, not a bank charge. See postman/README.md. Polling needs Collection Runner/Newman; Send does not follow setNextRequest. No real secrets or issued tokens are included.
